newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Slain girl's mother shoots suspect in Russia court.
newsitem.headline: Slain girl's mother shoots suspect in Russia court.

text.p: The mother of a teenage girl who was raped and killed last year in Russia's Far East avenged her daughter by shooting and wounding the suspected killer as he stood in the courtroom, Itar-Tass news agency said on Monday.
Summoned as a witness in the city of Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky, the mother withdrew an automatic pistol from under her shawl and shot once at the suspect.
He was taken to hospital and the woman was arrested. There was no immediate word on the suspect's condition.
